metadata.title: Minimalist Sepia Portrait with Venetian Blind Shadows

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast sepia portrait featuring a central figure interacting with geometric shadows cast by window blinds in a minimalist corner setting.
excludeWhen: busy or cluttered backgrounds are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic sepia-toned image of a woman in a dark slip dress kneeling in a minimalist white corner. Strong, diagonal parallel shadows from window blinds slice across the scene, creating a rhythmic geometric pattern that interacts with her body and the architectural lines of the room.
coreVisualRelationships: diagonal shadows contrasting with vertical corner line
dark silhouette of the dress against light-washed walls
outstretched arms mirroring the horizontal spread of the shadows
warm sepia palette unifying figure and environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, kneeling, occupying the middle third of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the subject's dress serves as the primary visual anchor against the bright background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal shadows from top-right to bottom-left, interrupted by the horizontal span of the subject's arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space on the left and right sides of the subject, defined by the clean lines of the corner walls.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia tones (creams and light browns) for the background and skin highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep chocolate brown and near-black for the dress and dense shadow areas.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone tan for the transition between light and shadow.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the bright light and the deep shadows.
paletteRestrictions: no cool tones like blue or green

letterConstructionRules: Wide tracking for the main title
High contrast between thick and thin strokes in the serif font
Fluid, handwritten style for secondary text

composition.relationshipToImage: floats in the upper negative space

composition.position: below main title and bottom right

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a formal, wide-tracked serif with a casual, intimate script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the high-contrast, elegant serif look for the main title.
Captures the fluid, handwritten feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned photograph of a woman in a dark slip dress kneeling in a minimalist white corner. Apply a strong venetian blind shadow pattern diagonally across the entire scene, ensuring the shadows wrap around her form and the walls.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a wide-tracked, light-weight serif font at the top center. Add secondary text in a small, lowercase script font directly below the title and in the lower right quadrant.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly sepia?
Are the blind shadows sharp and diagonal?
Is the main title tracking sufficiently wide?
Is the subject centered and kneeling?

adjustableVariables: tracking width of the serif text
mustRedesign: ensure the shadow lines are consistent across the subject and background
maintain a soft, diffused quality to the light despite high contrast
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent sepia grading across the entire frame.
Verify that the shadow pattern does not obscure the subject's face entirely.
Ensure the wide-tracked text is legible and balanced.
Confirm the minimalist corner geometry is preserved.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject in Minimalist Pose] + [Venetian Blind Shadow Pattern] + [Sepia Color Grading] + [Wide-Tracked Serif Typography].
